page_title: JUV 0-0 ACM | Juventus v AC Milan 27/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) swings in a cross from the corner, but Wojciech Szczesny reads it well and gathers the ball.
90+3' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
90+1' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
90+1' This shall not pass! Weston McKennie (Juventus) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

90' Danilo (Juventus) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
87' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) shows good awareness inside the box to meet a delightful cross from the free kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
86' The referee points to the corner flag and Juventus will take a corner.

86' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the left side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
85' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
84' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Juventus force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
83' Substitution. Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) replaces Christian Pulisic.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ruben Loftus-Cheek trots off the pitch and is replaced by Kevin Zeroli (AC Milan).
82' Stefano Pioli has decided to make a change. Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) replaces Yunus Musah.
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Kenan Yildiz as he is replaced by Fabio Miretti (Juventus).
80' AC Milan failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

79' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AC Milan.
78' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
77' Bremer (Juventus) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Maurizio Mariani signals. There is a free kick near the sideline to AC Milan.
76' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) takes the corner with a short pass.

76' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out for a corner. Juventus can continue in their attacking effort.
75' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Federico Chiesa (Juventus), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
74' A pass from Noah Okafor (AC Milan) is intercepted by Wojciech Szczesny and the move breaks down.

73' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the bottom right corner. Marco Sportiello shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
73' Weston McKennie (Juventus) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
71' Here is a change. Timothy Weah is going off and Massimiliano Allegri gives the last tactical orders to Weston McKennie (Juventus).
71' Substitution. Noah Okafor (AC Milan) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Olivier Giroud walks off.
70' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
69' Timothy Weah (Juventus) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
68' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.

66' What an opportunity! Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the right post!
64' Marco Sportiello (AC Milan) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
64' A pass from Federico Chiesa (Juventus) is intercepted by Marco Sportiello and the move breaks down.
63' Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) tries to play a long through ball into Rafael Leao, but the defence breaks the move down.
63' The game has come to an end for Filip Kostic. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Federico Chiesa (Juventus).
62' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) replacing Dusan Vlahovic.
62' Substitution. Yacine Adli makes his way off the pitch and Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) comes on as his replacement.
60' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
59' Adrien Rabiot floats in a cross for Kenan Yildiz (Juventus), whose header from near the penalty spot is really poor and goes well wide of the left post.
57' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
57' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. AC Milan will have a chance to score from a corner.
56' The ball is cleared after Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.

55' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) sends in a cross from the free-kick from the edge of the box. His effort is inaccurate and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.

54' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. AC Milan win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.

50' Filip Kostic (Juventus) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Marco Sportiello makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner. Danilo (Juventus) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the left-hand post. However, he couldn't beat Marco Sportiello, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
48' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
46' The whistle blows and Maurizio Mariani starts the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Juventus was in an offside position.
45+3' A quickly taken corner by Juventus.

45+2' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a fine strike towards the bottom right corner, but Marco Sportiello denies him with a great save. Juventus force a corner. They send men into the box.
45+2' Juventus get the opportunity to endanger the opposition's goal with a free kick from the edge of the box.

45+1' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Yunus Musah (AC Milan) for a foul that he committed a little earlier. Yunus Musah (AC Milan) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) swings it in and Kenan Yildiz gets on the end of it, but Marco Sportiello shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
41' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
39' Timothy Weah (Juventus) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
38' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
35' Christian Pulisic swings in a perfect cross for Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan), who unfortunately sends a poor header high over the bar from the centre of the box.
32' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just over the bar.
31' The corner kick is deflected to Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus), who immediately sends in a long-range shot. However, he hits the ball poorly and it goes high over the bar.
31' Juventus have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
30' Timothy Weah nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
29' Alessandro Florenzi fires in the corner, but the close-range bullet header from Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) lacks accuracy and ends well wide of the left post.
29' AC Milan earn a corner.
27' The game is interrupted now, Yunus Musah (AC Milan) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
27' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender. Now AC Milan have a corner.

25' What a poor attempt! Rafael Leao (AC Milan) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post.
22' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
22' Timothy Weah (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
21' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but Wojciech Szczesny comes off his line to gather the ball.
20' Referee Maurizio Mariani sees the trip by Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. A free kick to AC Milan.
19' The photographers scatter as a shot from the edge of the box by Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) blazes well wide of the right post.
18' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
17' Bremer (Juventus) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
16' Filip Kostic (Juventus) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
15' Federico Gatti (Juventus) receives the ball from Manuel Locatelli and tries to beat the keeper from long range, but the effort goes high over the bar.
12' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle as Federico Gatti (Juventus) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
8' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Marco Sportiello.
7' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) is able to continue to play.
6' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
5' Filip Kostic (Juventus) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
5' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
5' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. It will be a corner kick for Juventus.
2' Filip Kostic (Juventus) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Dusan Vlahovic, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Juventus will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Maurizio Mariani.
